name: i.safe MOBILE IS380.1
summary: The i.safe MOBILE IS380.1 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ia) 4G push-to-talk radio from i.safe MOBILE, certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs ISM-OS 16, with a user-replaceable battery.

atex.marking: II 2G Ex ia IIC T4 Gb / II 2D Ex ia IIIC T135°C Db

iecex.marking: Ex ia IIC T4 Gb / Ex ia IIIC T135°C Db

safety.conditions: EPS 25 ATEX 1 269 X / IECEx EPS 25.0060X: battery may be charged and replaced outside hazardous areas only; USB connection for charging/data only outside hazardous areas, to SELV/PELV/ES1 sources (Um ≤ 11.5 V); protect from high-energy impacts, excessive UV light and high electrostatic charge processes; USB-C and ISM interface covers must be securely closed in hazardous areas; Ta −20 °C to +55 °C. Only approved accessories on the 13-pin ISM interface (IS-HS1.1, IS-HDHS1x.1, IS-PTTB3A.1, IS-RSMG2.1, IS-RSM3C.1); nano-SIM cards meeting Uo 4.35 V, Co 80 µF, Lo 1 µH.

specs.keys: Side PTT; rotary channel/volume switch; red function/SOS key (next to antenna, assignable e.g. LWP)
specs.apps: App World (pre-installed; curated PTT and LWP apps)

capabilities.label: Push-to-talk
capabilities.value: Built in (side PTT key + PoC apps)

variants.name: IS380.M1
variants.description: Mining version, rated for Group I as well as Zone 1/21.
variants.marking: I M1 Ex ia I Ma

strengths: ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
A mining version (Group I) is also available
limitations: T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
No published end date for security updates
